svg.title: How I work
svg.desc: Flow: Protect deep work: fewer handoffs and waits. Feedback: Fast loops everywhere: build, test, review, ship. Focus: Less cognitive load: paved roads, clear docs. The long game: Platforms are never done: play the infinite game.
